text:
Anna W: Heads up — we need a small asset set for next week's launch + webinar promos. Scope: 4-slide carousel (social), responsive hero banner (1200x600 + 600x315), webinar 16:9 hero slide, and 3 social quote cards. Also need cutouts for speaker headshots, alt text, and copy variants. Deadline: Tue 9am PT. Can design take?

Samir M: I can pick this up. Quick Q: are we on the refreshed brand palette for these, or should I use legacy accent? Also — do you want a simple latency/cost stat card or a small comparison viz?

Leah (Design): Use refreshed palette (tokens v2). I'll do both a simple stat card and one stylized comparison tile so PMs can choose. Will deliver: 3 full-size PNGs, 3 mobile crops, 1 SVG for the stat tile, and a small Figma link. I will include alt text drafts and a color-contrast report.

Matt P (PM): Thanks — refreshed palette is correct. For routing: please embed UTM template for all social assets 
utm_source=social&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=inference_launch_2026 and include the campaign tag "inference-launch-2026" in the copy so inbound leads get auto-tagged in HubSpot. Also add a hidden form field value `source=webinar_post` in the webinar CTA so we can separate webinar responders.

Anna W: Perfect. Also need localized variants for EN/FR/DE — just copy overlays (no heavy art changes). Can Leah add mock copy blocks so ops can swap translations easily?

Leah (Design): Yes — I'll set text layers and export naming convention. Naming example: `assets/launch2026/carousel/slide-01_en_desktop.png`, `assets/launch2026/hero/hero_mobile_de.png`. Will include a CSV with copy keys.

Samir M: FYI — legal asked for a micro-legal line on the webinar slide: "Data based on internal tests; results may vary." Keep it 10pt max and low contrast per brand guidelines.

Leah (Design): Got it. Will add microcopy layer and a variant without it for .com hero. Also will run accessibility check and attach a screenshot of contrast ratios.

Matt P (PM): Routing checklist for ops: HubSpot tag `inference-launch-2026`, lifecycle set to `Lead` for webinar signups, assign source = `webinar_post`. If possible, add a custom property `creative_version` so we can A/B by creative.

Anna W: One more ask — can we get 3 headline copy variants for each social card (short, short+emoji, and long) so copy team can run quick iterations?

Leah (Design): Yup — will include headline variants in the CSV. ETA: initial mockups by Mon EOD, final exports Tue 8am PT.

Samir M: Thanks — tagging me for review when the Figma link is ready. :eyes:

design-bot: Uploaded draft frames to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/launch-2026 — files: `carousel_v1`, `hero_v1`, `stat_tile_v1`.

Anna W: Received — will review tonight. If all green, we can route to ops for HubSpot wiring tomorrow. :party-parrot:
